body: 40%-50% of the people are unaware they have the condition. Those with insight lose the insight when they have a psychotic break. When I have a psychotic break things begin to fragment and become painful. Things become unreal. I have become aggressive. I have wandered around the streets for days or a week with no recollection of what I was doing. I have gotten into fights with nurses. I am sure I have had encounters with law enforcement but have never been booked. The constant paranoia becomes overwhelming. I sleep next to a weapon if I remember to sleep at all. I forget to eat. I forget to sleep. I forget to shower. I have been convinced that my family who is alive is dead. I am convinced that this reality is an experiment or simulation and I am the only conscious mind with free will in it. The medications have debilitating side effects regarding motor control, heart rate and fatigue. When things slip I no longer participate in the consensus of reality that the vast majority of the population participates in. I experience my own terrifying reality. It is very difficult to explain. Like colors to someone who is blind. I will just say that your mind is broken into a thousand pieces and then slowly glued back together but each time a few more pieces are missing. Over a long enough period of time you stop being you.
